title: Soup loop conversation record
description: One line per model answer, appended to a conversation log (default layout: .soup-loops/traces/*.jsonl, the directory soup loop harvests by default). `id` identifies the answer; feedback records point at it through `response_id`. Readers ignore unknown fields. Lines without `schema_version` are version 0 (the pre-loop `soup serve --trace-log` line) and are not described by this schema.

id.description: The answer's id. Feedback.response_id refers to it.

conversation_id.description: The client's conversation key (the canary router hashes it). Any string the client chose, not necessarily a UUID; null when the client sent none.

model.description: The model name as served (a soup serve model id or path, an Ollama tag such as myproj:v2).

version.description: The loop version that answered (1 = the first deployed model, +1 per promoted iteration); null when the producer does not track versions.

adapter.description: Name of the adapter that produced the answer; null for the base model.

canary_bucket.description: Canary bucket the request was routed to; null when no canary split was active.

messages.description: The conversation the model saw, oldest first, WITHOUT the answer itself. Secrets are redacted by the writer.

response.description: The answer text (may be empty). Secrets are redacted by the writer.

finish_reason.description: Why generation stopped, e.g. stop or length (Ollama calls it done_reason).

latency_ms.description: Wall time from request to completed answer; null when not measured. Never a made-up 0.

tokens.description: Token counts as reported by the engine; null when the engine did not report one. Never a made-up 0.

options.description: Generation parameters the request used (temperature, top_p, max_tokens, ...).

^x_[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$.description: Producer extension namespace (x_<app>). Soup never reads or rewrites it.

uuid.description: A UUID in canonical lowercase form.

utc_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, suffix Z or +00:00.

source.description: Which surface produced the record. Known values: soup-serve (soup serve), playground, try_it, proxy (Soup Zero). Other lowercase names are accepted.
